role_guessing.possible_inference_leakage: Equal outputs for repeated questions and the one status:error sample can reveal pairing or suggest roles. Three repeated-question pairs are identical in this pack. This limits effective blinding even though no variant identities were assigned or mapping opened.
role_guessing.judgment_policy: The same evidence and oracle rules were applied to each sample independently of any possible role inference.

rubric.citation_exact: Every delivered citation must identify a supplied context and exactly match its Unicode code point slice and bounds. An error with no answer receives false rather than vacuous success.
rubric.claim_support: Every asserted fact, including optional examples, reasons and comparison details, must be supported by citations attached to that claim. Whole-context truth does not rescue missing selected evidence. Contiguous selected line fragments may jointly support a fact, and stated oracle alternatives are allowed.
rubric.completeness: All mandatory requested facets must be present in the answer prose under the fixed oracle. For an oracle requiring abstention because a facet is unknowable, an answered partial response is incomplete. This dimension is separated from citation support and does not certify evidence sufficiency.
rubric.language: The delivered answer must use the requested language; technical identifiers may remain in their original spelling.
rubric.temporal: Reporting, creation, proposal, expectation and actual completion must remain distinct; durations and event dates must not be conflated.
rubric.subject: Claims must preserve the correct entity, object, responsible party and scope.
rubric.conditions: Mandatory qualifications, conditional thresholds and scope restrictions must not be broadened or dropped from added factual assertions.
rubric.correct_abstention_or_answer: Status must match the fixed answerability oracle and required reason. status:error is never a successful abstention.
rubric.overall_correct: Conjunction of all eight quality booleans. This post-hoc result cannot reopen or pass the already-failed selection gate.
rubric.error_scoring: All quality booleans for a non-answer error are false. Unassessable language/semantic dimensions are not separately counted as observed hallucinations.
rubric.oracle_preservation: No oracle was rewritten. Stated alternative evidence was accepted as eligible; selected quotes need not duplicate oracle quote boundaries but must contain the required proposition.

limitations: This is post-hoc analysis of eight anonymous samples from only four attempted questions. Four of the eight planned questions were not executed.
The pack cannot establish quality on the full planned eight-question calibration, select a candidate, or demonstrate service success.

Questions and oracles are AI-authored and this is another AI judgment using the same general assistant ecosystem. Implementation separation and anonymous IDs do not eliminate common model-family or evaluation bias.
Human review count is zero. Effective role blinding is limited by repeated outputs and error shape.
All source comparisons use the contexts and fixed oracles embedded in this input pack. External originals, candidate code, raw run reports and sealed evaluation pools were not read.
No inference, model rerun, prompt tuning, output repair, service integration or oracle modification was performed.
